speaker: Doctor
text: WELCOME TO THE CONSULTATION. I AM DR. AGENT. I SEE YOU ARE A NEWBORN PRESENTING WITH RESPIRATORY DISTRESS. CAN YOU TELL ME HOW LONG YOU HAVE BEEN EXPERIENCING THESE SYMPTOMS AND IF THEY HAVE BEEN GETTING WORSE OR BETTER?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity.

Given the baby was born at 32 weeks via C-section with a mother with gestational diabetes, the risk for RDS is significant. I will now request a Chest_X-Ray to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes like meconium aspiration or TTN. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray. REQUEST IMAGES.
